summary.headline: Turin Codex Astrological Interrogations
summary.text: Catalogue of folios 52–58 of a Turin astrological codex, listing 15th-century notes on months and omens and interrogations concerning absent persons, lunar configurations, disturbances, slavery, letters, service, accusations, journeys, lost fugitives, royal correspondence, rumors, business, lawsuits, future actions, and illness. Cross-references cite Codices Venetici 6 and 7.
